page.layout: One printed page. Running text in one wide column at top (continuing from previous page, then Jerem. 33 passage). Below it, two columns: left column headed CXXIX with a title line and main text; right column of marginal-style notes with references (2. Cor. 1. v. 20 and 2. Timoth. 2. v. 13) beside it. Catchword/heading DICTA at lower right.

main_text.p: Ierem. 33. v. 8 9. Et mundabo illos ab omni iniquitate sua, qua peccauerũt contra me: & parcam omnibus iniquitatibus eorum, quibus peccauerunt contra me, & quibus præuaricati sunt in me. Et erit mihi in nomen, gaudium, laudem & gloriam apud omnes gentes terræ, quæ audierint omne bonum, quod ego faciam eis: & pauebunt & contremiscent super omni bono, & super omni pace quam ego faciam eis.
main_text.head: CXXIX. Quid sibi vult particula Amen?
main_text.p: Rem certam ac ratam esse. Nam precatio mea, multò certius est exauditaā Deo, quàm ego in corde meo sentio, me illud ex animo cupere2. Cor. 1. v. 20. (Quotquot enim sunt promissiones Dei, in ipso sunt Etiam, & in ipso sunt Amen) ad Dei gloriam per nos..
2. Timoth. 2. v. 13. Si infidi sumus, ille tamen fidus manet: negare seipsum non potest.
main_text.head: DICTA

page.notes: Marginal references are printed beside the left-column text; the right-column notes are transcribed as they stand. Some letters in the running text are faint and doubtful, notably "exauditaā" and "super o-" line endings.
